About Event

Healthcare AI Hackathon
Join OpenAI, AWS, JPM, Troutman Pepper, Pear VC, NEA, and Cathay Innovation for a one-day healthcare AI hackathon bringing together engineers, clinicians, researchers, designers, and founders to build products that solve real problems across healthcare.
Why Attend?
🏆 Compete for up to $5,000 in first/second/third place cash prizes, advisory meetings with our bank & law firm industry sponsors, and 1:1 pitch opportunities with PearX, NEA, and Cathay

🚀 Connect with leaders from OpenAI, AWS, J.P. Morgan, and leading VC-backed healthcare startups

🤝 Meet investors, founders, and operators shaping the future of healthcare

🏥 Collaborate with clinicians, engineers, researchers, designers, and entrepreneurs

💡 Build something with real-world healthcare impact

🌟 Demo your project to an audience of industry leaders and innovators

Food and drinks will be available

Presented by Pear VC · NEA · Cathay Innovation
Powered by OpenAI · AWS · J.P. Morgan · Troutman Pepper
Healthcare is the largest industry in the world, yet much of its infrastructure still runs on fragmented software, manual workflows, and administrative overhead. Recent advances in foundation models and AI agents have created an opportunity to rethink how healthcare is delivered, from the clinician desktop to the insurance back office to the patient experience.
Throughout the day you'll work directly with venture investors, startup founders, physicians, and operators who spend every day building healthcare companies.
Teams will leave with relationships, recruiting opportunities, and potentially the foundation for their next startup.
Whether you're already building in healthcare or just discovering the space, you'll spend the day working on problems that matter.
What Should You Build?
Build something that meaningfully improves healthcare.
We're less interested in incremental AI wrappers and more interested in products that unlock new capabilities, create new business models, or solve long-standing problems across the healthcare ecosystem.
Some areas we're especially excited about include:
🧬 Care Delivery & Clinical Innovation
Home-based care

Specialty care access

Precision medicine

Clinical trial enrollment

Diagnostics

Imaging

Robotics

Aging and longevity

New care delivery models

🏥 Healthcare Infrastructure & Financing
Medicare & Medicaid

Employer health

Alternative payment models

Value-based care

Provider operations

Healthcare marketplaces

Supply chain

Drug distribution

Healthcare infrastructure

❤️ Consumer Health
Women's health

Mental health

Family caregiving

Preventive health

Nutrition

Exercise

Chronic disease

Consumer engagement

Global health

These are examples, not constraints. If you have a compelling idea that improves healthcare, feel free to build it because we want to see it!

About Event

Stop making AI slop. Learn to direct AI films that actually look professional, then premiere yours on the big screen.

Roan Weigert will lead a practical masterclass covering creative direction, traditional filmmaking, AI generation, visual consistency, editing, sound, and delivery.
Roan has directed more than 1,600 videos for 400+ companies across 6 countries and has been featured on TV, print, radio, and online in the US and Brazil. He has published research in top journals, written a book on generative AI video, and repeatedly produced viral videos across platforms. He also creates on YouTube and hosts the AI Insights San Francisco podcast.
As DevRel AI Lead at GMI Cloud, Roan partners with frontier AI labs, which gives him firsthand knowledge of production workflows and early access to video-generation models before they launch publicly.
Partners from Frontier Labs will demonstrate their technology and support teams during the AI filmmaking hackathon.
You will leave with a finished short film, a practical production workflow, and new collaborators across filmmaking, technology, and generative media.
Sponsors will provide thousands of dollars in top AI tool credits for participants to use during the event and afterward, so they can continue creating.

About Event

Spatial Intelligence + Generative 3D Hackathon — Event Plan
World Labs × Tripo × mint.gg × Convex.dev · One-day hackathon · San Francisco
Overview
We're teaming up with World Labs , Tripo , mint.gg , and Convex.dev for a one-day hackathon in San Francisco at the intersection of spatial intelligence and generative 3D.
Participants will get hands-on access to some of the best tools for generating 3D content and turning it into functional, interactive experiences:
World Labs — large world models for generating immersive worlds

Tripo — rapid 3D asset generation for creating game-ready objects

mint.gg — agentic creation platform and developer tools for bringing worlds and assets together as interactive, playable experiences

Convex.dev — real-time backend infrastructure for powering application data, state, multiplayer systems, and agentic experiences

Together, we'll explore what becomes possible when entire worlds, detailed 3D objects, and real-time scenes can be generated from little more than a prompt or an image — and then quickly assembled, programmed, connected, and shared.
Tracks
Gaming & Interactive Worlds — Playable worlds, games, multiplayer experiences, interactive applications, and real-time 3D scenes

Physical AI & Simulation — Robotics, simulation, embodied agents, spatial reasoning, training environments, and digital twins

Creative 3D & VFX — Visual effects, virtual production, cinematic experiences, creative tools, real-time graphics, and experimental projects that do not fit neatly into the other tracks

Prizes
The top two teams in each of the three tracks will each receive:
$1k in World Labs credits

$1k in Tripo credits

$1k in mint.gg credits

That’s $3k in total credits per winning team .
With two winning teams across each of the three tracks, there will be six prize-winning teams .
Convex.dev will also give away Three Convex memberships. One to the top team in each tract.
Opening Ceremonies & Presentations

Attendees check in, grab coffee and breakfast, and receive their platform access and API keys

Opening briefing covering the three tracks, rules, judging criteria, prizes, sponsor giveaway, and what a finished demo should show

Hosted by Serge Alexander Didenko, Sean Klein & Artem Lukoianov

Register to See Address
San Francisco, CA

Registration

Approval Required
Your registration is subject to host approval.

Welcome! To join the event, please register below.
Request to Join

About Event

Sundai:
- a room full of people building moonshots - every sunday.
- born out of MIT & Harvard. 135+ hacks.
- aspire to beat the norm. aim higher.
------

the loop is already spinning. More than 80% of Anthropic's code is written by Claude. Jeff Dean left Google after 30 years to build the loop for science. Direction-setting is the role left for humans.
the hard part: Lilian Weng's survey of harness engineering argues the near-term path to RSI runs through the harness rather than weight-rewriting. A self-improving meta-harness is within reach. The bottleneck is evals, because a loop is only as good as its evaluator. That's the hack.
in the room: researchers from MIT CSAIL, Harvard, DeepMind and Meta Reality Labs. Co-hosted by Autolab and Maritime (MIT spinouts), EdotEnv (YC S26), YN.app and Sundai .

------

We will build agents that recursively self improve, or train models using autoresearch principles. Every sunday we will focus on a different aspect of RSI.
✨Schedule✨
10:00 Intros
10:15 Idea pitching and team formation
14:00 Check in #1 and lunch
20:00 Check in #2 and presentations
✨What is Autolab✨
A platform for Autoresearch. Autolab.ai runs your ML experiments for you - agents plan, launch, and score thousands of training runs in parallel, on your GPUs, against your evals.
✨What is Sundai✨
Sundai is the largest AI hacker community at Harvard & MIT, now building weekly moonshots in SF. Every sunday we ask each attendee to work on a aspirational larger than life moonshot idea that they always wanted to work on. One sunday at a time. This is your chance to push yourself to next level. We had done 130+ hacks back-to-back in the last 2 years - one for every sunday without stopping
✨What is Maritime✨
Maritime.sh makes it easy to host personal AI agents, agentic apps, and specialized agents for groups of users. You can build an app where every user gets their own dedicated agent, managed and hosted through Maritime, with simple tooling like the Maritime CLI and SDK.
✨What is E.env✨
E.env builds self-improving RL envs to teach LLMs general research skills from Quant Research tasks. structuredEvent.description:
Sundai: 
- a room full of people building moonshots - every sunday.
- born out of MIT & Harvard. 135+ hacks. 
- aspire to beat the norm. aim higher.
------

the loop is already spinning. More than 80% of Anthropic's code is written by Claude. Jeff Dean left Google after 30 years to build the loop for science. Direction-setting is the role left for humans.
the hard part: Lilian Weng's survey of harness engineering argues the near-term path to RSI runs through the harness rather than weight-rewriting. A self-improving meta-harness is within reach. The bottleneck is evals, because a loop is only as good as its evaluator. That's the hack.
in the room: researchers from MIT CSAIL, Harvard, DeepMind and Meta Reality Labs. Co-hosted by Autolab and Maritime (MIT spinouts), EdotEnv (YC S26), YN.app and Sundai.
